Country and location: India, Maharashtra, 10 km southeast of Dahanu
Notes: A two-year-old girl died after falling in a panic caused by the quake. There were also some reports of wall collapse.

Country and location: Mexico, Chiapas, 5 km southwest of Puerto Madero
Notes: More than 100 buildings were damaged in Chiapas, and one minor suffered a broken leg. In the neighbouring Guatemala, 15 people were slightly injured, and some houses also suffered structural damage.

Country and location: Indonesia, West Sumatra offshore, 170 km west southwest of Sungai Penuh
Notes: Eleven houses were destroyed, and a church and a health center were damaged in Mentawai Islands.

Country and location: Dominican Republic, La Altagracia offshore, 27 km south southeast of Boca de Yuma
Notes: At least 20 schools and other public buildings suffered minor damage.

Country and location: Azerbaijan, Ismaili, 23 km northeast of Basqal
Notes: Many houses were damaged, and cracks appeared on the walls of five schools. Thirty people needed medical assistance, three of them for serious injuries.

Country and location: Iran, Hormozgan, 73 km west northwest of Qeshm
Notes: Five people were hospitalized after the quake, and several buildings damaged.

Country and location: Northern Mariana Islands offshore, 423 km north of Saipan
Peru, Huancavelica, 49 km north northeast of Paucarbamba
Notes: Eight health centers were damaged, as well as houses and some buildings. Two people were injured, including an army officer.

Country and location: Papua New Guinea, New Ireland, 95 km north of Rabaul
Thailand, Lampang, 26 km southwest of Mae Chai
Notes: At least 15 buildings were damaged, including a pagoda. No injuries were reported.

Country and location: Turkey, Çanakkale, 10 km north of Ayvacık
Notes: 85 houses and two mosques were damaged near the epicenter. 21 people were injured.

Country and location: Japan, Hokkaido, 25 km east southeast of Chitose
Notes: This was an aftershock of the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi earthquake. The quake caused an avalanche in Atsuma and five people were slightly hurt in Sapporo, Tomakomai and Noboribetsu.

Country and location: Ecuador, Pastaza, 115 km east southeast of Palora
Notes: During the earthquake slight damage was reported, including broken windows and cracks in walls. One person died of a heart attack, and nine others were injured.

Country and location: China, Sichuan, 21 km northwest of Zigong
Notes: Nine houses were destroyed in Gongxian county. Two people were killed by a falling balcony guard bar and 12 people were injured, three of them seriously. Authorities have halted shale gas mining after the quake.

Country and location: Iran, Lorestan, 14 km east northeast of Abdanan
Notes: Slight damage to houses occurred, like cracked walls and broken windows. Seventeen people were injured.

Country and location: Indonesia, Sumatra, 83 km north northeast of Sungai Penuh
Notes: At least 48 people were injured and more than 350 houses damaged in South Solok district.
